about.intro: Hi! I'm Nikita, I'm {age} years old, known online as Nikitoss2ss, or simply Kuron! I'm from western Ukraine. I'm quite curious by nature, I love experimenting with technology, discovering new things, and of course drinking tea! 🍵
about.extra: If I trust my friends, I’m “interesting, nice, fun, and funny.” I’m pretty shy, especially when meeting someone for the first time, but I gradually become much more open. I also become very attached to people.
about.games: One more thing: I really love playing together! I don’t start games on my own very often because adventures are much more interesting when they’re shared with someone else.
about.furry: And one more important fact: I absolutely love furry culture! So much that I even have my own fursona. 🐉
interests: developing my own projects, experimenting with code, and using AI as a programming assistant.
computers, components, taking things apart, maintenance, and repairing various devices.
